ast-grep is judged by paths[0] ONLY, because contract §3 C2 says 'judge the FIRST element'. A call whose paths[0] is inside the band but paths[1] is a source path is therefore ALLOWED. Closing that needs the contract to say judge EVERY element; the module bound documents the reader, not this specific residual.

The MCP deny is by TOOL NAME (stated in the module): a source-returning MCP tool not in INVESTIGATION_TOOLS is open until added. mcp__lsp__rename_symbol / rename_symbol_strict are deliberately out (writes; already on the member read-only deny list).

Argument shapes are from this session's tool catalog: the eight LSP readers carry file_path, find_workspace_symbols carries only query, mpd_hashline_read carries path, ast-grep search carries paths. A future schema change that renames an argument would silently turn a judged tool into a bare-call refusal (fail-closed, never fail-open).
